one_line: OpenAI countersues Apple, Palantir secures a military AI deal with Poland, and Embo launches with $110M for robot world models.

themes.title: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets
themes.text: OpenAI filed a countersuit against Apple in a California court, accusing the iPhone maker of stealing trade secrets and coercing shared suppliers amid an ongoing dispute over employees and hardware.

stories.headline: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets and supplier threats

themes.title: Palantir signs $300M military AI deal
themes.text: Palantir secured a five-year, roughly $300 million contract to provide Poland with an AI-powered system called Saturn to aggregate data for military decision-making.

stories.headline: Palantir signs $300 million deal with Poland for military AI

themes.title: Embo launches with $110M for robotics
themes.text: Embo emerged from stealth with a $110 million seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz to train robot world models on internet video and humanoid fleet experience.

stories.headline: Embo emerges from stealth with $110M seed led by a16z for robot world models

themes.title: Small language models rival large models
themes.text: Small language models emerged as efficient alternatives requiring 10 to 100 times less computation while matching or exceeding larger models.

stories.headline: Small language models rival large models in 2026 with lower compute costs
